notes.title: New update, and new project on the way.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

   It's already been a week and almost 50 thousand people have downloaded Dev Guy. Quite remarkable actually. I'm grateful people have enjoyed it despite the valid concerns some have had.

   In response to player concerns though, an update was made for Dev Guy allowing players to skip certain minigames so they can continue without having to play through the pony game, or die constantly in “You have to up to jump”. This way players can enjoy the parts they like about dev guy and can skip the parts they have no interest in playing.

   In other news, A new Dev Guy project is already in the works. Not necessarily a sequel to Dev Guy, but definitely in the same vain. The new project will not be built in the UDK this time however, and will be also taking a very different artistic direction. More information about the new project will be posted as soon as feel comfortable releasing the news. During that time, I hope you all have enjoyed Warren's adventure, and I look forward to showing you the new project when it becomes readily presentable.


--Daniel
